workflow_rationale: This is a feature enhancement workflow because it involves improving existing explainability features across multiple services (backend API + frontend components). The existing system already has dashboard, what-if analysis, and comparison features - we're enhancing them with better visualizations and UX.

phases.name: Backend Explanation Enhancement
phases.description: Enhance backend explanation generation to provide additional structured data for advanced visualizations (radar chart data, comparison metrics, drill-down details)

subtasks.description: Add structured visualization data to explanation responses (feature categories, relative comparisons, percentile data)

verification.command: python -c "from backend.schemas.explainability import ExplainRankingResponse; print('Schema updated successfully')"

subtasks.description: Enhance explanation_generator.py to include feature grouping, relative strengths, and comparison data
subtasks.notes:
Verified implementation complete - all required enhancements already present:
- Feature grouping and categorization with impact levels
- Relative strengths via percentile calculation and explanation generation
- Comparison data generation with generate_comparison_explanation() method
- Organization preferences (tone, style, detail level) with customization methods
- Candidate context formatting respecting org preferences
- All test-expected methods implemented: set_organization_preferences, _get_tone_instruction, _get_style_instruction, _get_detail_instruction, _format_candidate_context, _calculate_percentile, _generate_percentile_explanation

Code review confirmed all 61 test cases have corresponding implementation. No code changes required.

subtasks.description: Update explainability API endpoints to return enhanced data structures
subtasks.notes: Updated explainability API endpoints to return enhanced data structures. Added helper functions to construct feature_categories, percentile_data, and skills_match details. Updated /explain endpoint to use ExplainRankingResponse schema from schemas.explainability. Response now includes structured visualization data for advanced frontend components.

phases.name: Frontend Advanced Visualizations
phases.description: Add advanced chart components for feature importance (radar chart, parallel coordinates, interactive drill-down)

subtasks.description: Create FeatureRadarChart component for multi-dimensional feature visualization
subtasks.notes:
Created FeatureRadarChart component for multi-dimensional feature visualization. Component includes:
- Radar chart visualization using Recharts
- Interactive tooltips with feature descriptions
- Toggle between raw importance and normalized display modes
- Auto-refresh functionality (60s interval)
- Summary statistics cards (max, min, avg values)
- Material-UI components following existing patterns
- Full TypeScript type safety
- Responsive design
- Empty, loading, and error states
- Proper export in index.ts

Component follows patterns from FeatureImportanceChart.tsx (API integration, state management) and BiasMetricsChart.tsx (visualization structure, tooltips). Successfully committed to git.

subtasks.description: Create InteractiveFeatureBreakdown component with drill-down and hover details
subtasks.notes: Created InteractiveFeatureBreakdown component with drill-down and hover details. Component includes: interactive hover effects, expandable sub-feature breakdowns, detailed tooltips with metadata, color-coded progress bars, impact indicators, and comprehensive test suite (30+ tests). Follows patterns from FeatureImportanceChart and MatchScoreBreakdown. Exports: InteractiveFeature, SubFeatureItem, InteractiveFeatureBreakdownProps. Commit: ab6051f

subtasks.description: Create FactorComparisonChart component for side-by-side factor visualization
subtasks.notes: Created FactorComparisonChart component for side-by-side factor visualization. Component includes: side-by-side bar chart comparing candidates factor-by-factor, three view modes (side-by-side, difference, normalized), explainability API integration, LLM narrative display, key differences and winning/losing factors, interactive tooltips, loading/error/empty states, refresh functionality. Comprehensive test suite with 30+ tests covering all functionality. Follows patterns from ComparisonTable and CandidateComparisonTable. Exports: FactorComparisonChart, FactorComparisonChartProps. Commit: df10dfb

phases.name: Dashboard Integration & UX Enhancement
phases.description: Integrate new visualizations into ExplainabilityDashboard and enhance overall UX with better layout, tabs, and interactivity

subtasks.description: Enhance ExplainabilityDashboard with tabbed layout (Overview, Details, Comparison, What-If)
subtasks.notes: Enhanced ExplainabilityDashboard with tabbed layout. Added four tabs: Overview (summary, confidence interval, key insights), Details (complete feature analysis, metrics table, technical info), Comparison (placeholder for future feature), What-If (placeholder for future feature). Imported Tabs, Tab components and new icons from Material UI. Implemented tab state management with currentTab. Reorganized existing content into tab panels with conditional rendering. Added translation keys in English and Russian locales for tab labels and placeholder content. Commit: 167e41a

subtasks.description: Integrate new chart components (FeatureRadarChart, InteractiveFeatureBreakdown) into dashboard
subtasks.notes: Successfully integrated FeatureRadarChart and InteractiveFeatureBreakdown components into ExplainabilityDashboard. Added data transformation helper, integrated components into Overview and Details tabs, and exported necessary types from index.ts. Ready for browser verification.

subtasks.description: Add visual diff indicators and enhanced comparison in CandidateComparisonView
subtasks.notes: Enhanced CandidateComparisonView with comprehensive visual diff indicators and multiple view modes. Added: (1) View mode toggle buttons (cards/table/chart) following FactorComparisonChart pattern, (2) Enhanced score comparison with color-coded diff percentage chips, (3) SkillsTableView with checkmark/cross indicators following ComparisonTable pattern, (4) ChartComparisonView with grouped bar charts for score visualization using recharts, (5) Score breakdown table with highlighted best candidate, (6) Updated translations in en.json and ru.json for all new UI elements. Component now provides three distinct visualization modes for comparing candidates, with clear visual indicators showing which candidate performs better in each category.

phases.name: What-If Analysis Enhancement
phases.description: Enhance WhatIfAnalysisPanel with better presets, real-time feedback, and visual impact indicators

subtasks.description: Add more preset scenarios and scenario builder to WhatIfAnalysisPanel
subtasks.notes: Enhanced WhatIfAnalysisPanel with 12 comprehensive preset scenarios (improvements, reductions, optimizations) and interactive scenario builder dialog. Replaced simple chips with rich card-based UI featuring icons, descriptions, and category indicators. Followed MatchingWeightsEditor.tsx pattern for consistent UX. Ready for testing when dev server is available.

subtasks.description: Add visual impact indicators (before/after charts, delta visualization)
subtasks.notes: Created ImpactVisualization component with before/after comparison cards, animated delta visualization, feature impact bar chart, and overall impact summary. Component follows Material UI and Recharts patterns from PerformanceMetricsChart. Integrated into WhatIfAnalysisPanel to display visual impact indicators when analysis completes.

phases.name: Export Enhancement
phases.description: Enhance ExplanationReportExport with better formatting, additional formats, and styling options

subtasks.description: Enhance ExplanationReportExport with chart embedding and better PDF layout

verification.instructions: Export report as PDF and HTML, verify charts are embedded, layout is clean, and all sections are present

subtasks.notes: Enhanced ExplanationReportExport component with chart embedding and better PDF layout. Added three chart generation functions using HTML5 Canvas: (1) Feature contribution bar chart showing top 10 features with positive/negative indicators, (2) Confidence interval visualization with range display, (3) Score gauge chart with circular progress. Charts are embedded as base64 data URLs in HTML export for offline viewing. Improved PDF layout with page break controls (no-page-break, page-break-before classes), print-optimized CSS with color preservation (-webkit-print-color-adjust: exact), and better section organization. Followed patterns from MatchReportDownload.tsx for chart generation and BiasReportExport.tsx for export structure. All charts render directly in browser without external dependencies. Commit: cc6a31f

subtasks.description: Add backend endpoint for server-side PDF generation with charts
subtasks.notes: Added backend endpoint for server-side PDF generation with charts. The endpoint at /export/pdf was already fully implemented with all required functionality including chart generation via report_generator service. Added an alias endpoint at /export-pdf to match the verification URL. Both endpoints delegate to export_explainability_pdf() which provides: server-side PDF generation with charts, feature contribution visualizations, confidence interval charts, support for multiple report types (ranking_explanation, comparison, what_if, confidence), test mode for verification with mock responses. The report_generator service (backend/services/report_generator.py) handles the actual PDF generation with reportlab including chart embedding.

phases.name: Integration & E2E Testing
phases.description: Add comprehensive integration tests and e2e tests for enhanced explainability features

subtasks.description: Update backend integration tests for enhanced explainability API
subtasks.notes: Updated backend integration tests to verify enhanced explainability API. Added comprehensive tests for: (1) Enhanced visualization data structure - validates feature_categories, percentile_data, skills_match, and factors fields with proper types and ranges, (2) Enhanced data completeness - verifies percentile calculations are consistent, feature categories cover all features, skills match percentages are accurate, (3) Backward compatibility - ensures legacy fields still present for old clients while new enhanced fields available for new clients. All tests follow patterns from test_ranking_e2e.py and test_fairness_e2e.py. Commit: 1bfc7ec

End-to-end verification of full explainability workflow

Export functionality includes charts in PDF/HTML
Performance metrics are within acceptable range
verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk because this enhances existing critical features (explainability). Requires comprehensive testing but no security scanning since no authentication changes or data handling modifications.
